Introduction

This is a sample document used by the bookstack-to-pdf test suite. It exercises the cover page, table of contents, headings, and a code block.

Configuration

BookStack reads EXPORT_PDF_COMMAND from .env:

EXPORT_PDF_COMMAND="/usr/local/bin/bookstack-to-pdf {input_html_path} {output_pdf_path}"

Permissions

Make sure the binary is executable by the BookStack process user.

Tables

FieldDescription
company.nameDisplayed in cover and footer.
branding.logoLocal path to the logo image.

Closing

End of sample document.
